name: Sitora Driver Intelligence
checkpoint_summary: Marketplace-agnostic Driver Intelligence blueprint agreed, and Sitora Project State v2 is now built with a live dashboard and JSON API so future chats and agents can recover the latest checkpoint from the repository.
vision: Build the intelligence infrastructure between motorists and automotive marketplaces: understand the driver, match needs to vehicle capabilities, guide better choices, learn from outcomes, and create permissioned aggregated intelligence for the wider automotive ecosystem.
non_negotiables: User experience and better car choice come first; commercial intelligence is a consequence, not the primary user experience.
Explain why each discovery question is asked and how the answer improves recommendations.
Do not reduce the product to AI search, better filters, an MOT score, or generic car comparison.

Support accessibility and passenger needs including babies, children, mobility limitations, wheelchair use, sensory needs, neurodivergence, sight/hearing loss, cognitive support needs, carers, and older passengers.
Keep the core engine marketplace-agnostic so local marketplace partners can be swapped country by country.
Where commercially feasible, Sitora retains the proprietary ontology, scoring, learning logic, and outcome model while partners consume outputs via APIs.
architecture: Driver Intelligence Graph: longitudinal profile of past cars, likes/dislikes, lifestyle, passenger needs, driving habits, economics, priorities, avoids, changing circumstances, and feedback.

Vehicle Capability Graph: detailed make/model/trim/spec capabilities including practicality, accessibility, comfort, safety, sensory factors, technology, powertrain, reliability, ownership cost, and depreciation.
Matching Ontology: maps human statements and needs to measurable vehicle capabilities and constraints.
Decision Engine: separates hard constraints, strong preferences, desires, and avoids; ranks suitable vehicle types/models/trims and explains trade-offs.
Marketplace Translation Layer: converts the final structured requirements into the best filters/facets supported by Auto Trader or another local marketplace.
Outcome Learning Loop: learns from viewed/rejected/shortlisted/purchased cars and later ownership satisfaction, repairs, resale, and regret to improve future recommendations.
current_state: Core strategic framing agreed: Sitora is the intelligence engine before marketplace filters, not a competing marketplace.
UK scale partner concept: Auto Trader can become the intelligence infrastructure connecting UK motorists with the automotive industry.
Discovery should capture the full driver picture, then use hard constraints/specification matching first and softer preferences/feedback second.
Last three cars are a key discovery input: what they were, why chosen, likes, dislikes, what should be repeated or avoided, and why changed.
Vehicle recommendations should be feature/spec/trim aware and explain exactly why a vehicle suits or conflicts with the user's needs.
Recommendation loop should remain interactive: recommend, collect reaction, adjust profile, refine shortlist, and offer deeper analysis.
Final consumer handoff should preconfigure marketplace filters wherever the marketplace supports them.

Aggregated/permissioned intelligence can serve dealers, manufacturers, insurers, finance, warranty, leasing/fleet, charging, service/repair, roadside assistance, auctions/remarketing, and policymakers.
International direction agreed: UK first, then marketplace partnerships in the US and other major markets including Australia, Canada, Japan, and China.

Project continuity layer v2 is implemented in the Sitora repo: project JSON files are readable through a reusable server library, /api/project-state exposes machine-readable live state, and /project-state provides a visual dashboard for checkpoints, next actions, issues, and decisions.
next_actions: Design the complete Driver Discovery specification and map every question to a driver signal, vehicle capability, recommendation impact, and available Auto Trader filter/facet.
Research and document the current Auto Trader filter/facet structure and identify which requirements need Sitora's own Vehicle Capability Graph rather than direct marketplace filters.
Define Vehicle Capability Graph v1 schema at model/trim/spec level.
Define Driver Intelligence Graph v1 schema including hard constraints, strong preferences, desires, avoids, confidence, recency, and source of signal.
Design the first clickable prototype flow from discovery through refined shortlist and Auto Trader handoff.
Add write/authentication and optional database sync to Project State only if repository-based checkpoints become limiting; Git + JSON remains the source of truth for now.
open_issues: Final product/engine name is not locked.
Exact Auto Trader API/filter access and commercial integration route need verification before production integration.
Vehicle specification data sources and licensing terms need to be selected.
Longitudinal outcome-data collection needs privacy, consent, retention, and governance design.
Commercial structure with Auto Trader could be paid pilot, licence, JV, strategic investment, or acquisition; no route is locked yet.

recent_decisions.decision: Sitora should build the Driver Intelligence engine as the core moat rather than a marketplace or generic search UI.
recent_decisions.reason: Marketplace owners can copy UI features; the harder-to-copy asset is the driver graph, vehicle capability graph, ontology, decision logic, feedback loop, and outcome data.

recent_decisions.decision: The engine should translate natural human needs into the best marketplace filters after its own deeper vehicle-capability matching.
recent_decisions.reason: Auto Trader already excels at live inventory; Sitora's differentiated role is understanding the human and preparing the right search universe.

recent_decisions.decision: Accessibility and passenger needs are first-class discovery inputs.
recent_decisions.reason: A recommendation must fit everyone who actually uses the car, and these needs often cannot be expressed by standard marketplace filters.

recent_decisions.decision: The core engine must remain marketplace-agnostic for future international partnerships.
recent_decisions.reason: Auto Trader is a possible UK scale partner, while Sitora's long-term asset should work with different marketplaces in the US, Australia, Canada, Japan, China, and other markets.

recent_decisions.decision: Project continuity v2 should expose repository checkpoints through a dashboard and read-only API while keeping Git + JSON as the authoritative source of truth.
recent_decisions.reason: This makes state easy for humans and agents to inspect without introducing database drift before one is actually needed.

implementation.database: No project-state database yet; repository JSON remains authoritative.
implementation.deployment: Project State dashboard implemented at /project-state and read-only JSON API at /api/project-state; awaiting merge/deployment.
